subject: Lumenix Academy (SF) — joint roadshow + co-marketing details
messages:
From: Ava Moreno <ava.moreno@lumenix.io>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: Markus Li <markus.li@lumenix.io>
Date: Fri, 03 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal — Lumenix Academy SF stop (May/June)

Hi Ben —

Hope youre well. Lumenix is planning a 3-city "Lumenix Academy" roadshow focused on product teams using vector search and retrieval augmented generation. Wed love Redwood Inference to co-present at the San Francisco stop (we expect ~120 attendees: product managers, ML engineers at mid-market startups).

High level ask from our side: 30-minute joint talk (Redwood + Lumenix), a 10-minute live demo slot, 2 co-authored blog posts (pre/post), and shared webinar recording for lead capture. We can cover venue and basic AV; asking partners to share promotional email to their list and provide a short speaker blurb.

I attached a one-pager and a proposed SF agenda. Potential dates: May 18, May 25, or June 8. Any of those work for you?

Would love to pull in your partnerships or marketing lead if helpful — copying Markus on logistics.

Cheers,
Ava Moreno
Head of Events, Lumenix
attachments: Lumenix_Roadshow_OnePager.pdf, Proposed_SF_Agenda_v2.pdf

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Moreno <ava.moreno@lumenix.io>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 03 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal — Lumenix Academy SF stop (May/June)

Hi Ava —

Thanks — this sounds like a great fit. May 25 and June 8 look best for us; leaning to May 25 for pre-summer timing.

Quick notes / asks from the Redwood side:
- Wed like a 35-minute co-present slot (15 minutes Redwood product + 15 minutes joint architecture demo + 5 minutes live Q&A).
- Request 5 minutes before show to verify AV and network for the demo.
- Can you confirm expected attendee titles and whether there will be a sponsor table for a booth?
- We'll provide speaker bios and a short pre-event blog draft by May 3 if date confirmed.

Marking monica (partnerships) and stephanie (demand gen) to handle logistics and promotional cadence. Sergio from alliances can help on the joint architecture outline.

If it helps, we have a short speaker one-pager I can send along.

Best,
Ben Carter
Strategic Partnerships, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | redwood.ai

Ben / Monica —

If we lock May 25, marketing timeline below:
- Apr 9: confirm speaker names and titles (for landing page)
- Apr 16: provide 1-page co-marketing copy and shared email copy
- Apr 23: email blast 1 to partner lists / social cadence begins
- May 10: final registration push + reminder to speakers

Budget / promotional: can we secure $2,500 towards a sponsored email or paid social boost? If Lumenix can cover venue but not promo, we should split paid promotion 50/50. Monica — can you confirm if partner marketing funds are available or if we route this to RevOps for a promo credit?

Also attaching a short doc with our standard speaker bio format. Ill draft the co-blog outline once we confirm the agenda (Sergio, can you take point on the architecture demo bullets?).

- Stephanie

Hi Ava —

Thanks for the invite — May 25 works for Redwood. Were happy to co-promote. A couple quick items:
- Can Lumenix confirm sponsor table availability and whether theres space for a compact demo setup (1 table + 1 monitor)?
- We can commit to the requested co-authored blog and the recording distribution.
- We have a small partner marketing fund; I can allocate up to $1,250 if Lumenix matches. Please advise how you prefer to invoice that (PO vs. credit).

Also confirming our speakers: Ben Carter (partnerships) and Sergio Alvarez (solutions architecture). Ill send the finalized speaker bios by Apr 9.

Thanks — looking forward to collaborating.

Monica Patel

Fantastic — May 25 booked.

Quick confirmations:
- Venue: The Lab SF (capacity ~150). Sponsor table and single monitor demo area confirmed.
- Promo: Lumenix will match $1,250 promo spend and run paid social for two weeks. We prefer an invoice/PO for partner contribution; please send PO to events@lumenix.io and well issue a credit.
- Logistics: AV check at 4:00pm on the day-of; doors open at 5:30pm; talk scheduled 6:15pm.
- Please share speaker bios and a 2-paragraph preview for the landing page by Apr 9.

Attaching final venue logistics and the registration link. Ill set up a short planning call next week to align on slide outline — sending a Calendly in a separate email.

Thanks everyone — excited to do this together.

Warmly,
